content.text: The fuzzer caught a real bug: with a single combined register, each rule's *start* bit must be forced every step (`INIT` mask), not just bit 0. Fixing:

arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
src = open('main.py').read()

old = """    # terminal bits: bit (o_r + k_r - 1) reports an occurrence of rule r
    TERM = 0
    TR = [-1] * total
    off = 0
    for i in range(NR):
        b = off + RLEN[i] - 1
        TERM |= 1 << b
        TR[b] = i
        off += RLEN[i]
"""
new = """    # terminal bits: bit (o_r + k_r - 1) reports an occurrence of rule r.
    # INIT forces every rule's position-0 bit on each step, so that every rule
    # may start a fresh occurrence at any packet.
    TERM = 0
    INIT = 0
    TR = [-1] * total
    off = 0
    for i in range(NR):
        b = off + RLEN[i] - 1
        TERM |= 1 << b
        TR[b] = i
        INIT |= 1 << off
        off += RLEN[i]
"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

old2 = """                D = ((fl[2] << 1 | 1) & MASKS[f + 2048])
                fl[2] = D
                tt = D & TERM"""
new2 = """                D = (((fl[2] << 1) | INIT) & MASKS[f + 2048])
                fl[2] = D
                tt = D & TERM"""
assert old2 in src
src = src.replace(old2, new2)

old3 = """                    D = 0
                    for f in st[11]:
                        D = ((D << 1 | 1) & MASKS[f + 2048])"""
new3 = """                    D = 0
                    for f in st[11]:

assert old3 in src
src = src.replace(old3, new3)
open('main.py','w').write(src)
